title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Attachment Surcharge on Long Rentals
content:
Long Ridgeline Tool Rental rentals carry an attachment surcharge on accessories not returned.

**Clause.** Long rentals carry an attachment surcharge: on an agreement whose rental time includes a four-week period the charge is multiplied by 1.20; on one whose rental time includes weekly periods but no four-week period, by 1.10; on one billed in daily periods only, it is unchanged.

The multiplier acts on the accessories charged multiplied by the class charge per accessory not returned, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

The rate periods are those of the rental time lines on the agreement.

| Rental time lines on the agreement | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| include a four-week period | 1.20 |
| include weekly periods, no four-week period | 1.10 |
| daily periods only | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (three accessories at 25.00, that is 75.00 before the multiplier)

| Periods billed | Figure |
|---|---|
| one four-week period and one week | 90.00 |
| two weeks | 82.50 |
| five days | 75.00 |
